_comment: Model knowledge-cutoff registry. A backtest window must start AFTER the model's EFFECTIVE cutoff (cutoff + buffer_days) or its decisions may be contaminated by memorized outcomes. DIRECTION OF CONSERVATISM: contamination lies BEFORE the cutoff, so when sources disagree adopt the LATEST candidate date (max across sources) and add buffer_days (30-60) for residual uncertainty — an early date would classify contaminated dates as clean, defeating the gate. 'verified: true' means the OPERATOR adopted the value after research and takes responsibility for it (some vendors, incl. DeepSeek/Meta/Mistral, publish no official cutoff — record the basis in 'note'). Unverified/null entries classify as 'unknown' (never guessed clean). Dates are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

deepseek-v4-pro.note: No official cutoff published by DeepSeek. V4 released 2026-04; third-party aggregators cluster near the release date. Adopted max(sources)=release month end + 60d buffer (operator research 2026-08-02). Effective cutoff 2026-06-29 -> only ~1 month of clean window as of 2026-08; see HANDOVER for the dual-track plan.

deepseek-v4-flash.note: Same basis as deepseek-v4-pro (no official value; release 2026-04; max+60d).

deepseek-v3.note: No official cutoff. Third-party sources conflict (Oct 2023 vs Jul 2024); adopted max=Jul 2024 + 60d buffer (operator research 2026-08-02). Effective 2024-09-29 -> ~23 months of clean window: the long-window validation model.
